limitations: Published hardware exception inputs and profile-excluded LOCK prefixes are not passes.
Most hardware profiles select three deterministic eligible cases per file; the full-circle profile selects two explicit cases.
Rotate hardware coverage is 36 count-one cases plus two full-circle carry cases, not general variable-count coverage.
POPAD upperESP behavior on16-bit stacks follows measured386EX captures; not a general386DXhardware claim.
REP interruption policy and later-Intel fault-EFLAGS guidance remain separately documented.
